capabilities.name: Blueprint contract and validation
capabilities.web: Validates and renders the spec through @texuli/spec and @texuli/player.
capabilities.native: Validates the same spec version from the generated Kotlin; invalid fixtures are refused identically.

capabilities.name: Semantic conformance (golden traces)
capabilities.web: Writes one semantic trace per golden blueprint and per parity fixture.
capabilities.native: Produces the same trace for every golden and every parity fixture; a semantic gate, not a pixel test.

capabilities.name: Label interpolation (i18n messages)
capabilities.native: Produces the same strings on the shared interpolation vectors.

capabilities.name: Painting catalog components
capabilities.native: The ids in NativeRegistry; every other id paints a visible placeholder (see the table).

capabilities.name: Design systems and tokens
capabilities.web: Validates, compiles and applies any design-system document (@texuli/tokens).
capabilities.native: Decodes documents and validates the envelope reference; ships token sets compiled on the web side (Default and Acme); no Kotlin compiler for a brand document yet.

capabilities.name: Decks
capabilities.web: Deck model v2 with masters, transitions, notes and aspect (@texuli/deck, @texuli/slides).
capabilities.native: Paints the deck layout and slides as titled sections; masters, transitions, notes and aspect paint a placeholder.

capabilities.name: Workflows
capabilities.native: Validates workflow graphs identically; the graph does not paint natively.

capabilities.name: Documents, forms, canvas and sheets
capabilities.native: Validates their envelopes and caps; no painter, no form expressions, no sheet formulas.

capabilities.name: Data sources and dashboards
capabilities.web: Host data sources and the dashboard (@texuli/data).
capabilities.native: Validates sources; data components paint a placeholder.

capabilities.name: Agent tools (MCP)
capabilities.web: The local and remote MCP servers (@texuli/mcp, texuli.com/mcp).
capabilities.native: None: the tools run in Node and on the edge, not inside an app.
